# Is storing your grain worth it? Find the break-even price

> Free store-or-sell calculator for grain farmers. Enter harvest moisture, drying, storage and interest costs and later bids; it shows what each later price nets versus selling at harvest and the break-even price. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
